primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-apply-cube (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1895-1912

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: form the difference module M combining the four positive pullbacks m_{1,2,3}, m_1, m_2, m_3 with the three negative pullbacks m_{1,2}, m_{1,3}, m_{2,3}; the theorem of the cube (0BF4) applies once M restricts trivially on each of the three axis slices A x A x e, A x e x A, e x A x A; on each slice the pullback indices collapse so the positive and negative factors cancel pairwise (the residual e^*L being a trivial line), which is exactly the displayed trivialization; the conclusion is the 4-vs-3 isomorphism (source lines 1914-1941)
